data.name: Mount Simon Formation (Cms)
data.descrip: Primarily medium- to coarse-grained quartz sandstone, with a pebble conglomerate near the basal contact with the Precambrian. Thickness in Dane County ranges from about 300 feet (90 m) to over 600 feet (180 m). Part of the Elk Mound Group.

data.name: Cambrian, undivided
data.strat_name: Trempealeau Formation; Tunnel City Formation; Elk Mound Formation
data.descrip: Sandstone with some dolomite and shale, undivided; includes Trempealeau, Tunnel City, and Elk Mound Formations
